# awbrowse

> A portable browser client — navigate, console, network, DOM, screenshot.

Handing an agent a screenshot makes it read a picture of text; handing it raw DOM makes it read a megabyte of markup. Neither of those is the page.

## Install

```
pip install awbrowse
```

## In Claude Code

- skill: `/awbrowse`

## Use it in 30 seconds

Drive one page and get back what is on it in a form worth reasoning about.

## Composes with

- [awdk](https://aitherium.github.io/awdk/) — Build AI agent fleets — 3 lines, any backend, local or cloud.
- [awfind](https://aitherium.github.io/awfind/) — A portable search client — query, results, ranking.
- [awsh](https://aitherium.github.io/awsh/) — Your terminal answers you -- type a question where a command would go.
- [awprove](https://aitherium.github.io/awprove/) — Drive a page as the real user, check what rendered, and get a test that goes red if it stops being true.
